To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed several low-complexity iterative detection algorithms based on message passing for large-scale multiuser multi-antenna OFDM systems.

the proposed message-passing based algorithms can achieve near-optimal detection performance at a complexity much lower than the state-of-the-art detection algorithms for large-scale multiuser OFDM systems.

we propose a novel message passing algorithm for large-scale multiuser multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems, and that the proposed algorithm can achieve a near optimal performance while the complexity can be reduced by tens of times.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the low-complexity iterative detection for large-scale multiuser OFDM systems

the design of low-complexity message passing algorithms for multiuser MIMO systems, where the message updating is performed in a low-complexity manner by approximating discrete messages with Gaussian messages and then using the expectation propagation technique, the a posteriori probability, the first-order message, and the central-limit theorem to compute the Gaussian message.

developing a class of iterative message passing algorithms for large-scale multiuser multi-input multi-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing systems, and the proposed message passing techniques can achieve near-optimal detection performance with low complexity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the message passing algorithms can provide an effective way of designing low-complexity detectors for multiuser MIMO systems.
the proposed message-passing-based algorithms can achieve a performance close to that of the STS-SD and the turbo MMSE-SIC, while the complexity is reduced significantly.
the proposed message updating techniques are effective and efficient in reducing the complexity of the message passing algorithms while achieving near-optimal performance in large-scale MIMO systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a low-complexity message passing algorithm to solve the detection problem in multiuser MIMO systems and demonstrate its effectiveness in both large-scale and low-dimensional MIMO systems.
we have proposed a low-complexity message-passing algorithm for large-scale MIMO-OFDMA systems and have demonstrated its performance and complexity tradeoffs.
we have developed a novel message passing framework for multiuser MIMO detection and proposed efficient algorithms to achieve near-optimum performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the message passing algorithms can serve as a good candidate to detect the large-scale multiuser multi-antenna systems, which is of practical importance for future wireless communication networks.
the proposed message updating can be used as a low-complexity alternative to the STS-SD and the iterative (Turbo) MMSE-SIC for large-scale MIMO systems.
, for a low-dimensional system, the proposed message-passing algorithms are capable of achieving a near-optimal error performance with a low complexity.
